description: This file defines a culture info object for the Arabic (Syria) locale in the DateJS library, including localized names for days and months, date/time format patterns, regex patterns for parsing, timezone info, and various date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero, leaving only the date.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time components of the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same timestamp.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date instance with another.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day name (e.g., Sunday=0).

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month name (e.g., January=0).

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
